district: City and County of San Francisco
summary: A Yes vote enacts a parcel tax to fund Muni public transit operations.

tax.text: Imposes a tiered parcel tax on residential and commercial properties to fund public transit operations.
tax.quote: If approved, the measure would establish a tiered parcel tax on commercial and residential properties to fund the agency, which is facing a massive deficit.

transit.text: Dedicates local parcel tax revenues to SFMTA public transit operations to avoid service reductions and fund transit expansion.
transit.quote: revenue from the parcel tax imposed by this measure is required to go to the SFMTA for transit operations expenses

tax.text: Opposes establishing a new annual parcel tax on San Francisco property to fund Muni transit operations.
tax.quote: Prop H would create a new annual tax on most property in San Francisco to fund Muni
